title: Bound on the cast successor index
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and $N$ gates. For every $d$ with $0\le d\le N$, the value of $d$ regarded as an element of the successor embedding into indices from $0$ through $N+1$ is at most $N$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs with N gates
d is an index in the range 0 through N
